name: desktop-look
description: Make the terminal transcript look like the Claude Code apps: your prompts in a round bubble, tool calls as one line with a state mark, lists set in with bullets, the text between tool calls set apart, and an info band

bubbleWidth.title: Bubble width
bubbleWidth.description: How wide your own messages may grow, as a share of the terminal

showBand.title: Info band
showBand.description: Show the band above the prompt (tools running, and the model and context fill when turned on below)

bandModel.title: Band: model
bandModel.description: Show the model and effort in the band (off when your status line already shows them)

bandContext.title: Band: context
bandContext.description: Show the context fill in the band (off when your status line already shows it)
